# api (auto-generated)

## Purpose
Auto-generated TypeScript API client from backend OpenAPI spec. Generated by `openapi-typescript-codegen` via `npm run generate-api`.

## Subdirectories

| Directory | Purpose |
|-----------|---------|
| `core/` | HTTP request infrastructure — OpenAPI config, ApiError, CancelablePromise, request handler |
| `services/` | Generated service classes — one per backend controller (Auth, Courses, Lessons, Modules, Enrollments, Quizzes, Payments, Coupons, Students, VideoBookmarks) |
| `models/` | Generated TypeScript interfaces — mirrors backend DTOs (requests, responses, enums) |

## For AI Agents

### Working In This Directory
- **DO NOT EDIT** any files in this directory — they are auto-generated
- To update after backend API changes: `npm run generate-api` (backend must be running on :8080)
- The generation script lives in `frontend/scripts/generate-api.js`
- If you need custom API logic, add it to `src/lib/` (e.g., `auth.ts`, `admins.ts`) not here
